description: Source code for the MultiRegionClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, providing functionality for managing multiple regional clients and creating commands for AWS operations.

classes.name: MultiRegionClient
classes.description: A multi-region AWS client implementation that manages regionalized clients and constructs AWS commands.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the default argument definitions for the client configuration, including the client factory and partition settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the multi-region client with provided configuration options, including setting up handlers, argument resolution, and region partitioning.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the default region to which the client is configured.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates a command object for a specified AWS operation, with optional transfer-specific parameters.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the client configuration options or a specific option if provided.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns the credentials used by the client.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list used for command processing.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the API description for the client.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint URL for the client.

methods.name: useCustomHandler
methods.description: Sets a custom handler for commands.

methods.name: isUseCustomHandler
methods.description: Checks if a custom handler is set.

methods.name: getClientFromPool
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a regionalized client from the pool based on the region.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses the class name to determine the service name.

methods.name: getRegionFromArgs
methods.description: Extracts the region from command arguments or defaults to the client's configured region.
